jobs.title: VP, Finance Excellence and Transformation
jobs.description:
VP, Finance Excellence and Transformation
Amentum is a global leader in advanced engineering and innovative technology solutions, trusted by the United States and its allies to address their most significant and complex challenges in science, security and sustainability. Our people apply undaunted curiosity, relentless ambition and boundless imagination to challenge convention and drive progress. Our commitments are underpinned by the belief that safety, collaboration and well-being are integral to success. Headquartered in Reston, Virginia, we have approximately 50,000 employees in more than 70 countries across all 7 continents.

Job Summary
Amentum is seeking an experienced and strategic Vice President of Finance Excellence and Transformation to lead a technology centric enterprise-wide Finance transformation.  Following a period of rapid growth through multiple acquisitions and integrations this position will play a critical role in unifying our finance landscape and creating a scalable, integrated future-state operating model that supports Amentum’s long-term profitable growth objectives.

Partnering with the entire CFO leadership team and key stakeholders across other enterprise functions and operations, a primary objective of this role is to design and deliver a multi-year transformation roadmap that leverages technology to strengthen our processes, systems, data, and governance.

Reporting to the Senior Vice President, Enterprise Finance, this position is part of Amentum’s Finance organization. We prefer a candidate local to Reston, VA but we will consider remote-telework candidates. US Citizenship is required.

Key Responsibilities:
- Developing the Transformation Vision: Collaborate with CFO leadership team to create a compelling, well-defined finance transformation vision that aligns with the broader organizational strategy and identifies opportunities for value creation.
- Stakeholder Engagement: Establish a stakeholder management strategy to secure buy-in and support from key stakeholders. This includes engaging with business leaders early in the process to foster collaboration and address concerns.
- Change Management: Partner closely with Finance, Contracts, IT, HR, and Operations leaders on effective change management while harmonizing processes and ensuring alignment and adoption of new tools and standards.
- Assess current-state processes, systems, legacy platforms, and organizational structures to identify gaps, inefficiencies, and integration challenges related to our M&A-driven growth.
- Lead the end-to-end strategy, planning, and execution of an enterprise-wide finance transformation program.
- Coordinate and oversee day-to-day activities across project phases, including scope definition, dependency management, resource allocation, and milestone tracking.
- Drive continuous improvement and modernization initiatives including financial system automation, data governance, and reporting enhancements.
- Set and track key performance indicators (KPIs) that measure the success of transformation initiatives. Regularly review KPI’s with leadership to communicate program updates, risks, mitigation plans and need to adapt strategies if applicable.
- Manage diverse stakeholder groups to drive initiatives impacting a variety of end-to-end processes including, but not limited to, Hire-to-Retire (H2R), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Order-to-Cash (O2C), and Record-to-Report (R2R).
- Oversee cross-functional project teams, external consultants, and technology vendors.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:
- Data-driven and continuous learning mindset — Candidates should demonstrate curiosity, adaptability, and the ability to learn new technologies quickly, including leveraging AI to automate repetitive tasks, synthesize information, improve communication, and accelerate problem solving while maintaining human judgment and accountability.
- Ability to evaluate and apply emerging technologies — Candidates should be comfortable assessing new AI-enabled tools and processes, identifying practical use cases, validating outputs, understanding limitations/risk, and incorporating AI responsibly into day-to-day work.
- Demonstrated AI fluency and workflow integration — Candidates should have experience using AI tools to enhance workflows, productivity, decision-making, customer experiences, business outcomes, or operational efficiency.
- Strong understanding of government contracting financial requirements, including FAR, CAS, indirect rate structures, and audit readiness.
- Experience driving multi-phase cross-functional projects involving ERP systems, adjacent functional systems, process automation, and data/reporting modernization.
- Strong executive communication skills and experience presenting to C-suite stakeholders, to include storytelling capabilities to convey the transformation vision effectively to diverse audiences.
- Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams, manage complex change, and influence without direct authority.
- Demonstrated experience creating governance frameworks, KPIs, and transformation performance metrics.
- Strong understanding of advanced digital technologies and their application in finance operations with the ability to leverage technology to enhance efficiency and accuracy.
- Strong skills in relationship-building and conflict resolution to engage stakeholders and address resistance effectively.
- Ability to define strategic objectives aligned with corporate goals and lead the team towards achieving these objectives through a structured approach.
- Demonstrated program leadership and execution to lead cross-functional finance transformation projects spanning process standardization, automation, and data integrity.
- Continuous improvement mindset focused on learning from past initiatives to refine future strategies is paramount for success in this role.
- Adaptive to changes in business priorities and capable of adjusting the transformation strategy as the organization evolves.

Minimum Qualifications:
- Typically 12–15+ years of progressive experience in Finance, Program Finance, or Financial Operations, with at least 5 years leading enterprise-wide finance transformation initiatives.
- Bachelor’s degree in finance, accounting, business, or related field; master’s degree is preferred.
- Proven track record of leading finance teams and managing transformation projects with proven success managing post-M&A financial process integration, legacy system consolidation, and data harmonization in a complex Govcon environment.
- US Citizenship is required to apply.

The Finance Manager will lead financial planning, analysis, and reporting for large-scale Space Force programs. Purpose and Impact:

We are seeking an experienced and data-driven Program Manager to lead a multidisciplinary team of analysts and engineers supporting a client’s performance measurement program.

The Program Manager – Data Analytics will serve as the primary point of contact for the Government, providing overall leadership, direction, and oversight for all contractor personnel. This role ensures the successful execution of program tasks, delivery of high-quality outputs, and expert support across performance management, business analytics, and technical domains.

Additionally, the Program Manager will act as the key liaison to the Contracting Officer’s Technical Representative (COTR), managing all contract-related matters, including cost, schedule, and overall performance.

Work Schedule: M-F, 40 hours/week (Flex time, Comp time, and Extended Work Week (EWW) approved)

Essential Responsibilities:

- Plan, direct, and schedule the timely and successful completion of the work on the contract.
- Monitor program performance regularly for conformance to original program scope and maintain continual reviews to ensure that all terms and conditions are met in accordance with legal requirements, customer specifications, and government regulations.
- Maintain on-going coordination with contract support team to ensure timely and accurate completion and/or delivery of monthly and as-needed program requirements.
- Prepare and disseminate Monthly Contract Status Report (MCSR) to the client regarding contract status, compliance, satisfaction, and limitations.
- Serve as the single focal point to the COTR for managing all tasks and subtasks.
- As Principal Representative for project direction, provide the COTR and CO with information and solutions regarding significant issues that will have a direct impact on the contract.

- Provide daily oversight and management of personnel contract hours including but not limited to timecard submittal, review, approval, reconciliation, troubleshooting, and resolution of discrepancies.

- Conduct bi-weekly workstream review and planning meetings with all personnel assigned to the contract.

- Engage regularly with staff to identify organizational gaps and opportunities.
- Gather program/project requirements and evaluate, analyze, and propose operational and technical solutions.

The work environment is fast-paced and sometimes involves extreme deadline pressures. The nature of the work requires a high degree of teamwork and cooperation with other members of the staff as well as individuals across the Company and Customers.

Attendance is critical at all times. Must be able to work a 40-hour workweek, normally Monday through Friday.  However, times and days may vary depending on business requirements. Needs to be available to work overtime during critical peaks and be available to meet last minute requests for overtime should the situation occur.

Must be able to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing
Grooming and dress must be appropriate for the position and must not impose a safety risk/hazard to the employee or others. Must put forward a professional behavior that enhances productivity and promotes teamwork and cooperation.

Must be able to interface with individuals at all levels of the organization both verbally and in writing. Must be well-organized with the ability to coordinate and prioritize multiple tasks simultaneously. Must work well under pressure to meet deadline requirements. Must be willing to travel as needed.
